Metre coordinates describe disjoint clear-space boxes, not walls. No doors or windows are seeded. Empty areas are unassigned shell, exterior, courtyard, or the explicitly described void.
Exactly two stair footprints and two lift footprints are vertically stacked reservations on every floor. They are not physical stairs, lifts, shafts, or installed equipment.

Public, controlled and service labels and circulation zones express intended thresholds. Access edges are reciprocal same-floor adjacency intentions, not installed doors or an enforced security policy.

No structural, fire, accessibility, egress, acoustic, laboratory safety, sporting-body, or transport-operational compliance is asserted. Reservations do not model inter-floor travel or exit discharge.

Three longitudinal routes distinguish public hearing access, controlled case preparation and judicial access. Courtroom blocks can address both public and controlled routes. The route connections require future designed screening/controlled doors; no custody cells, prisoner transfer system or security certification is implied. Hearing rooms are single-storey, not fictitious stacked double-height courts. Courtrooms are equal 14 by 8.5 m internal bays between the public gallery and the controlled route; case rooms face an open light court.
